static: Inspected the frozen protocol, non-FMA ORO Algorithms 3.1-3.3 and 5.3/5.4 grouping, residual-only change, accepted factor/first-correction gates, guarded BVLS-02 assessment, result schema, and cost partition.
Read the primary Ogita-Rump-Oishi paper and checked its IEEE-754, overflow, underflow, n*eps, EFT, and 25*n-7 hypotheses against the conservative prototype admission policy.
ran: Frozen AST/preflight check with independent 25*22-7 = 543 arithmetic count.
Synthetic admitted EFT identities and NaN, positive/negative infinity, subnormal input, splitter overflow, nonzero-product underflow, and signed-zero controls.
not_run: Rust, engine, physics, or physical evaluator execution.

algorithm_checks.grouping: PASS: initial TwoProduct; then TwoProduct, TwoSum, q+r, s+(q+r); final p+s, with each operation binary64 and no FMA/reassociation.
algorithm_checks.eft_hypotheses: PASS for admitted execution: all inputs/intermediates must be finite normal or signed zero; every non-FMA TwoProduct multiplication is guarded; splitter overflow and nonzero-product underflow refuse; exact Fraction identities are checked outside the candidate path on all admitted retained operands.
algorithm_checks.oro_bound_scope: PASS: n=22 gives n*eps<1. The paper permits bounded underflow, while this prototype conservatively refuses it and therefore relies on exact EFT identities only after admission. No exact-rounding guarantee is claimed.
algorithm_checks.precise_change: PASS: correction 1 replays accepted ordered-binary64 residual/factors and bit-gates delta/p; only correction-2 residual formation changes to Dot2; masks, factors, update order, lambda, radius, bounds, and BVLS-02 predicate remain fixed.
algorithm_checks.complete_acceptance: PASS: complete BVLS-02/box/ball, normal-domain guard, active-value preservation, and active-bound equality are conjoined.
algorithm_checks.cost: PASS pre-run: 543 arithmetic operations per 22-term row and 11403 per 21-row residual; guards, predicate branches, exceptional branches, identities, factor applications, updates, assessment, and factor reconstruction remain separately reported.

resolved_findings: The initial dash/underscore import failure was preserved as dot2-pre-run-rejected-01 and replaced with an explicit file loader.
The accepted guarded assessment helper was corrected, and normal-domain status now enters complete acceptance.

Historical Decimal-200 grouping, actual ULP distance, true exact-minimizer error, dependency receipt checks, executable primitive controls, branch accounting, and active preservation acceptance were added before measurement.
verdict: PRE-RUN RELEASE for exactly one result-bearing two-case execution at the reviewed hashes. Any source/protocol/primitive change, extra case/correction, or predicate change voids this release and requires re-review.
